rule.note: Once an hour, average three z-scores from the previous 30 days only. Futures-spot gap is futures close / spot close - 1, then multiplied by -1 so a cheap future (crowd short) is positive. Funding rate is multiplied by -1 so negative funding (shorts paying) is positive. The 1-hour fractional change in open interest is multiplied by -1 so a fall (forced out) is positive. Buy when this score is above the 98th percentile of scores on the previous 30 days. Entry is the next 1-minute open. Exit is the open 4 hours later. One position at a time. Funding is applied.
